topic: BREAKTHROUGH: the DMA path was crippled by an unset L2 cache policy, not saturated

discovery.reading: setting l2_cache_ctrl explicitly lifts the UB->GM write path from 1.13 to about 3.08 TB/s (2.7x) and the GM->UB read path peaks at 2.35 TB/s with NORMAL_LV. The earlier conclusion that the write path was saturated at 1.13 TB/s was wrong: it was the default policy of an unset hint.

improvement: v18 is 13% faster than v16 on the stable candidate-time metric
pending: v19 (NORMAL_LV read + NORMAL_FV write) is correctness-clean and deterministic but its gate is still blocked by device contention
correction: R64 concluded the copy path was saturated at 1.7 TB/s aggregate. That conclusion is withdrawn: it measured the unset-policy path.
status: prefill gate now 0.772 in the v18 window; candidate time 0.0648 ms, the best so far
